blind.description: A copper fish kettle or oblong covered roaster featuring an elongated oval body, a matching fitted lid with a brass loop handle, and two loop handles mounted on each narrow end. The model has solid, continuous metallic surfaces with a warm polished copper finish and brass hardware, sitting flat on its bottom.
blind.from_above: An elongated capsule or stadium shape with a central straight handle on top and two small loop handles extending outward from the ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 to 6 inches tall (less than 1/10th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet long.
